atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Defines Tailwind CSS theme variables, such as colors and fonts, that generate utility classes.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Applies existing Tailwind CSS utility classes, including responsive variants, inside a CSS rule.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Defines a custom Tailwind CSS variant, such as the mobile, tablet, compact, laptop, and wide breakpoints in this project.
